import ledger


def _encode(cents):
    """Encode an integer amount in minor units to the house wire format.

    Format: <sign><digits>#<check>
      sign   '+' if amount >= 0 else '-'
      digits absolute amount in minor units, no decimal point
      check  (sum of the decimal digits in <digits>) mod 10
    """
    sign = '-' if cents < 0 else '+'
    digits = str(abs(cents))
    check = sum(int(d) for d in digits) % 10
    return "{}{}#{}".format(sign, digits, check)


def record(acct, cents, note):
    """Post `cents` (integer minor units) to `acct` with memo `note`.

    Returns the new entry id produced by ledger.post.
    """
    return ledger.post(acct, _encode(cents), note)

from ledger import post


def _encode_amount(cents):
    """Encode an integer minor-unit amount into the house-private wire form.

    Format: "<sign><digits>#<check>" where <sign> is '+' or '-', <digits> is
    the absolute amount in minor units (no decimal point), and <check> is
    (sum of the decimal digits in <digits>) mod 10.
    """
    cents = int(cents)
    sign = '-' if cents < 0 else '+'
    digits = str(abs(cents))
    check = sum(int(d) for d in digits) % 10
    return "{sign}{digits}#{check}".format(sign=sign, digits=digits, check=check)


def record(acct, cents, note):
    """Post `cents` (integer minor units) to account `acct` with memo `note`.

    The amount is serialized using the ledger's wire-encoding invariant before
    being handed to ledger.post. Returns the new entry id.
    """
    return post(acct, _encode_amount(cents), note)

import ledger


def _encode(cents):
    """Encode an integer amount in minor units to the house-private wire form.

    Format: <sign><digits>#<check>
      sign   '+' for non-negative, '-' for negative
      digits absolute amount in minor units, no decimal point
      check  (sum of decimal digits in <digits>) mod 10
    """
    sign = '-' if cents < 0 else '+'
    digits = str(abs(int(cents)))
    check = sum(int(d) for d in digits) % 10
    return "{}{}#{}".format(sign, digits, check)


def record(acct, cents, note):
    """Post `cents` (integer minor units) to `acct` with memo `note`.

    Returns the new entry id produced by ledger.post.
    """
    return ledger.post(acct, _encode(cents), note)
